Palette identity, side/back forms, transparent boundaries and one-cell registration remain coherent. No additional body, palette or lighting defect was found.

Native source evidence confirms the intended display-only change: d is one constant and the ray-offset drivers/Z change together. Rig/actions, contact paths, body/knife geometry, camera, materials, lighting and canonical texture/UV/aspect/width remain fixed. That technical correctness does not satisfy v3’s separate explicit requirement to keep E/W food legible without new burial or cut-off fragments.
